differences.what: A module, exam_msk_1, that the General note type includes: its section Musculoskeletal shows only while MSK (exam.systems is msk) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal. Musculoskeletal is two modules, one for each piece: exam_msk_2 holds the parts E to H.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory section 7 (pieces 10 and 11), default 10

differences.what: Every part after the region is asked once for each region picked, as a grid whose rows are the regions picked, not as a repeating section with one entry per region. The parts are in two pieces, so in two sections, and the second section could not read the region of an entry of the first: a section names one piece, and a condition or a grid's rows cannot name a field inside a repeating section from outside it. The answers are still one per region.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 16; forms 6.3 (a departure: 6.3 makes MSK one repeating section, which the two pieces cannot be)

differences.what: The guidance line is not typed.
Where are you examining? is choose-many: several regions can be examined in one exam. Normal picks none. Other asks for a short text.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 16, 29, 31; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): Normal does nothing in MSK until a region is picked (default 29 asks)

differences.what: Side (Oct 19) is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), each cell choose-one from the shared list side: Right, Left, Bilateral (added). It is asked for Head / Neck and Back too: a grid's cell cannot depend on its row.
differences.why: PRD main 103; focused-exam inventory default 4 (a departure: the default does not ask it for Head / Neck and Back)

differences.what: Once a region is selected: every part after the region has a row only for each region picked, so nothing is asked before one is.
Inspection is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others.

Palpation is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-many; No tenderness is the normal option and clears the others. Each row also asks Pain for that region, a whole number from 0 to 10 out of 10, only while Tenderness is picked there. Normal leaves Pain empty.

Range of motion is two grids, Active and Passive, each for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-many from the shared list range_of_motion: Full is its normal option and clears the others; Limited and Painful can be held together.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory section 5 (range of motion), default 13, 16, 26
